theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the surviving leader with the highest durability (0.73) and good breadth (0.889) relative to the narrow eligible set. I treat this as a trend-following, vol-aware lean in the direction of confirmed leadership, NOT a return forecast; the crowding flag (z 1.78) is a size-down caution only and does not justify fading. Given gate_helps is false and the detector is display-only here, conviction is capped at low.
evidence: crowding_z 1.78 / crowded true (sizing caution, not a fade)
hurst_tag mixed (not clean trend — tempers conviction)
theses.dissent: A mean-reverting A-shares tape has historically whipsawed trend-following on this market (gate_helps false), and Banks at crowding z 1.78 with 'mixed' (not 'trend') hurst is late-cycle attention that often marks a local top; the survivorship bias of leading the rank is exactly the documented failure mode.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS closes below its 20-day moving average AND lags the CSI 300 by more than 2% over a 5-day window before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma is a coin-flip challenger to Banks (margin 0.01), also eligible, with strong durability (0.60) and likewise crowded (z 1.59). It is not a confirmed handoff — the leader has not been displaced — so this is a conditional tilt toward the only other genuinely eligible, high-durability theme rather than a next-narrative call. Same display-only caution applies.
theses.dissent: The rotation structure is explicitly directional=false and one_narrative=false; treating a near-tied challenger as an independent overweight risks over-paying for a crowded theme that has not actually taken leadership, and cross-sectional momentum has no forward edge on this market.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ underperforms 512800.SS by more than 3% over any 10-day period before the check-by date, or its durability_bar drops below 0.45.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is one of only four eligible themes (rank 6, score 0.495) but carries a 'mean-revert' hurst tag — the one leg of the detector that has historically signaled drawdown risk — and low breadth (0.30). In a market where the trend gate already fails, a mean-reverting eligible theme is the weakest kind of leadership and offers no directional edge.
evidence: hurst_tag mean-revert (only eligible theme with this tag)
theses.dissent: Coal is nonetheless ELIGIBLE by the absolute-trend gate and is the least crowded eligible theme (z 0.58), which in a reflexivity framework means it could be the one prior to its own crowding — an 'avoid' may miss a legitimate value rotation in Financials & Value leadership.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS closes higher for 15 consecutive trading days and its hurst tag flips to 'trend' before the check-by date.
